name: alpha-tocopherol + hyaluronic acid
purpose: It cleans the area of eyebrow oil and glands and moisturizes the dryness around the eyes
uses: Use it whenever you need to clean your eyelids
otcwarn: 1. Consult a specialist if you have abnormal symptoms or side effects such as red spots, swelling, or itching due to direct sunlight during or after using this product. 2. Please refrain from using the wound area 3. Precautions for Storage and Handling A. Please keep it out of the reach of children. B. Please store it in a cool place. 4. Wash it immediately when it gets into your eyes.
